title: Return & Refund Policy
intro: At ARÔME HOUSE, we are committed to providing a convenient and reliable shopping experience. Please read the following terms carefully before submitting a return or refund request.

sections.title: Return Eligibility
paragraphs: Return requests can be submitted within a maximum of 7 days after the order has been received. Returned products must be accompanied by proof of purchase and remain in their original condition. Requests submitted after this period may not be processed.
If your claim concerns damage or a defect present when the product arrived, our team will review the original condition using the evidence you provide.

sections.title: How to Request a Return
paragraphs: Contact ARÔME HOUSE Customer Support and provide the following:

Once your request has been approved, our team will provide the return address and further shipping instructions. Package the product securely to prevent additional damage. Do not send a return before receiving approval.
items: An unboxing video showing the condition of the product when first received.
A photo of the shipping label or tracking number.

sections.title: Refunds
paragraphs: After we receive and inspect the returned product, we will inform you of the status of your refund request. If approved, the refund will be processed within a maximum of 3 × 24 business hours through the payment method used for the purchase.

sections.title: Product Exchanges
paragraphs: Exchanges are available for verified defects or damage, including leakage, a loose cap, or other product damage. The exchange process begins after the returned product has been received and the issue has been verified by the ARÔME HOUSE team.

sections.title: Non-Returnable Items
paragraphs: Returns are not accepted for the following, except where a damage or incorrect-product claim has been reviewed and approved by our team:
items: Perfumes opened or used, or products with damaged security seals.
Special editions or bundles specifically stated as non-returnable.
Perfumes broken after receipt, outside an approved damage claim.
Fragrance preference complaints, including longevity, differences from a tester or previous purchase, alcohol smell, or fragrance intensity.
Complaints relating to spray-nozzle malfunction without an approved defect claim.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: For questions about returns, exchanges, or refunds, contact ARÔME HOUSE Customer Support through the Contact Us page.
